title: Fine-Grained Natural Language Inference Based Faithfulness Evaluation for Diverse Summarisation Tasks
reasoning: The paper uses the term 'faithfulness' in the context of factual consistency in summarization, defining it as 'the degree to which a summary accurately represents the content of the input document.' It focuses on detecting factual errors, grammatical errors, and content units not supported by the source document. There is no evaluation or benchmarking related to religious faith, morals, or ethics.
